en: have a bias towards action.
zh: 要有行动偏好。

en: You've probably seen that, or at least an iteration of it on a poster,
zh: 你大概见过这句话，或者至少见过它的某个变体，印在海报上，

en: or a Nike t-shirt, or maybe a David Goggins thirst trap.
zh: 或者印在耐克T恤上，又或者出现在 David Goggins 那种秀狠劲的视频里。

en: But what if you are taking action?
zh: 但如果你其实已经在行动呢？

en: What if you read, you learn, and you consume constantly.
zh: 如果你一直在读、在学、在持续不断地吸收信息呢？

en: but still haven't built anything yet?
zh: 可你还是还没真正做出任何东西呢？

en: That is a different problem.
zh: 那就是另一个问题了。

en: When I was in my 20s, I thought I'd beaten Brain Rot.
zh: 我二十多岁的时候，我以为自己已经战胜了脑腐。

en: I'd be listening to Andrew Huberman podcasts at the gym instead of music.
zh: 我会在健身的时候听 Andrew Huberman 的播客而不是听音乐。

en: I'd take Ubers, and instead of doomscrolling.
zh: 我坐 Uber 的时候，不再像以前那样刷那些让人越看越空虚的内容。

en: I'd save articles and highlights into ReadWise and sync them with my notion.
zh: 我会把文章和高亮内容存进 ReadWise，再同步到我的 Notion 里。

en: And in my free time at home.
zh: 而在家里的空闲时间，

en: I was doing flashcards and I was reading.
zh: 我也在背闪卡，也在读书。

en: instead of watching anime or Netflix.
zh: 而不是看动漫或者 Netflix。

en: By every definition, I was productive.
zh: 按任何一种标准来看，我都算得上高效。

en: Months and years went by when you're supposed to be compounding all this learning
zh: 几个月、几年过去了，照理说，这些学习本该不断复利积累，

en: and becoming this Chad version of myself.
zh: 让我变成那个更强、更厉害的自己。

en: But when I really looked at it, I was in the exact same place.
zh: 但当我真正回头看时，我发现自己其实还停留在原地。

en: And I realized that learning, consuming, reprogramming bad habits, that is the first step,
zh: 我这才意识到，学习、吸收信息、纠正坏习惯，这些都只是第一步，

en: but it doesn't really get you anywhere.
zh: 但它们本身并不会真的把你带到哪里去。

en: When I was 22, I made the crazy decision to become a doctor.
zh: 我22岁时，做了一个很疯狂的决定：去当医生。

en: And in order to become a doctor, I needed clinical experience.
zh: 而想成为医生，我需要临床经验。

en: So I became an EMT.
zh: 所以我去做了 EMT。

en: And one of the very first things you learn in BLS training is
zh: 而在 BLS 培训里，你最先学到的事情之一就是

en: how to perform CPR.
zh: 怎么做心肺复苏。

en: Things like compressions being two inches deep.
zh: 比如按压要达到两英寸深。

en: knowing how many compressions for every time you deliver oxygen, different indications for different kinds of people.
zh: 比如要知道每送一次氧该做多少次按压，以及针对不同人群的不同适应指征。

en: I even got to practice on dummies many, many times.
zh: 我甚至还在假人身上练习过很多很多次。

en: I passed the tests, I got one of the highest scores in the EMT school that they'd ever seen.
zh: 我通过了考试，在 EMT 学校里拿到了他们见过的最高分之一。

en: And I'm not gonna lie to you, boosted my ego a little bit.
zh: 我不骗你，这确实让我有点飘了。

en: I felt ready. I felt like if someone actually collapsed in front of me,
zh: 我觉得自己已经准备好了。我觉得如果真有人倒在我面前，

en: that I would know exactly what to do.
zh: 我未必会确切知道该怎么做。

en: And on my second shift ever as an EMT.
zh: 结果就在我当 EMT 的第二次值班时，

en: it was Valentine's Day actually.
zh: 那天刚好还是情人节。

en: And for some reason, everybody in the company called out or took the day off.
zh: 不知为什么，公司里几乎所有人不是请假就是休息了。

en: So we get called to this grocery store and we walk into the bathroom
zh: 于是我们接到任务赶到一家杂货店，走进洗手间

en: and I see this man collapsed on the floor by the urinal.
zh: 我看到一个男人倒在小便池旁边的地上。

en: My partner rushes over, does his quick ABC, feels for a carotid pulse,
zh: 我的搭档立刻冲过去，快速做了 ABC 检查，又摸了摸他的颈动脉搏动，

en: and he looks at me, and he said so calmly, start compressions.
zh: 然后他看着我，很冷静地说，开始按压。

en: Even though I knew the protocols and I'd done compressions on countless dummies,
zh: 虽然我知道所有流程，也在无数个假人身上做过按压，

en: it was a completely different experience.
zh: 但那完全是另一种体验。

en: So we got on an actual human being.
zh: 因为这次，我们面对的是一个真正的人。

en: In about 20 compressions in.
zh: 大概按压到第20下的时候，

en: I hear this cracking sound.
zh: 我听到了一声骨头裂开的声音。

en: and nobody tells you this beforehand.
zh: 而且事先根本没人告诉过你这一点。

en: but those are ribs that crack there.
zh: 但那就是肋骨被压裂的声音。

en: And I remember my paramedic looked at me and he said, don't worry,
zh: 我记得当时那位急救员看着我，对我说，别担心，

en: that's fine. That's how you know you're doing it right.
zh: 没事的。这说明你做对了。

en: That patient didn't make it.
zh: 那个病人最后还是没救回来。

en: And let me tell you, that changes you quickly.
zh: 我告诉你，这种事会很快改变一个人。

en: There's a difference between knowing something and being able to do it.
zh: 知道一件事，和真正能做到它，是两回事。

en: Psychologists call it the fluency illusion.
zh: 心理学家把这叫作流畅性错觉。

en: The more you're exposed to something.
zh: 你接触某件事越多，

en: the more you hear it, read it, study it, watch it, the more familiar it feels.
zh: 你越常听它、读它、学它、看它，它就会让你感觉越熟悉。

en: You've never actually done it because it's still in your head.
zh: 可你其实从来没有真正做过，因为它始终还只停留在你的脑子里。

en: It's like you're running on a treadmill.
zh: 这就像你在跑步机上跑步。

en: You're sprinting, you're sweating.
zh: 你在冲刺，你在流汗。

en: It feels like you're making progress.
zh: 感觉自己好像在进步。

en: but you haven't actually moved anywhere.
zh: 但实际上，你根本没有真正移动到任何地方。

en: You've consumed enough. It's time to start creating.
zh: 你已经吸收得够多了。现在该开始创造了。

en: Test your theories, share your ideas, vibe code some cool shit, solve problems,
zh: 去验证你的理论，分享你的想法，凭感觉写点酷东西，解决问题，

en: and build an audience.
zh: 然后建立起自己的受众。

en: Why an audience? Because knowledge that stays inside of you helps nobody.
zh: 为什么是受众？因为只停留在你体内的知识，帮不了任何人。

en: Without creating things for other people, you can't deliver value.
zh: 如果你不为别人创造东西，你就无法真正提供价值。

en: You can't transfer belief.
zh: 你无法传递信念。

en: You can't build an honest reputation that creates real leverage for you.
zh: 你也无法建立起一种真实可信、能为你带来真正杠杆的声誉。

en: The freedom to work on the things that you love and actually have people recognize you for what you've done.
zh: 那种自由，是你可以去做自己热爱的事，而且人们会因为你做出的成果真正认识你。

en: Aristotle said this quote 2,300 years ago.
zh: 亚里士多德在2300年前就说过这句话：

en: for the things we have to learn before we can do them,
zh: 凡是那些我们必须先学会才能去做的事，

en: we learn by doing them.
zh: 我们都是通过去做，才学会的。

en: I've been publishing consistently for seven years now and there's no end in sight.
zh: 我已经持续发布内容七年了，而且看不到尽头。

en: I've never regretted once pressing publish.
zh: 我从来没有后悔过一次按下发布。

en: I've only regretted not doing it.
zh: 我后悔的，只有那些没发出去的时候。

en: And if you're ambitious and you know that there's more that you're capable of,
zh: 如果你也有野心，而且你知道自己本可以做到更多，

en: stop consuming and start creating.
zh: 那就别再一味吸收了，开始创造吧。
